sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Constriction in pharynx. Sore throat with
tightness in naso-pharynx.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea. Uncontrollable vomiting even of
water followed by extreme weakness.

Back and Extremities. — Tired feeling in back and
neck and shoulders. Paral 3 rtic weakness. Wrist tires
easily from writing. Extreme weakness from climbing
stairs. Stiffness of thigh and calves. Arms feel as if
no strength in them.
